_: Lab game owners (D-553, docs/LANES.md): a contributor whose PR brought a game into the lab owns it while it is in the lab. A later PR of theirs that touches only their own games (see GAME_PATHS in lanes.mjs) takes the lane of its files instead of 🔴, so it merges without the owner's tick. Adding an owner here is itself 🔴: the owner approves it, normally in the PR that brings the game in.
